items.title: Police suspect human remains to be abducted Sydney man
items.description: Eighty-five-year-old Chris Baghsarian was mistakenly snatched from his North Ryde property about 5am on February 13.

items.title: Victorian premier refers allegations against gynaecologist to police
items.description: Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan has referred allegations against gynaecologist Simon Gordon to police, but the government will not conduct its own investigation.

items.title: 'Your word against his': Women's complaints against surgeon dismissed by regulator
items.description: Australia's medical regulator, AHPRA, faces criticism for failing to act on complaints from patients about surgeries by Melbourne gynaecologist Simon Gordon.

items.title: Grace Tame abuser unfit to stand trial over alleged 'menacing' social media posts
items.description: Nicolaas Ockert Bester has been deemed unfit to stand trial in the Hobart Magistrates Court over three counts of using a carriage service to menace, harass or cause offence.

items.title: Developer behind Gold Coast Trump Tower proposal went bankrupt twice
items.description: A search by the ABC of federal insolvency records reveals the developer has had personal financial scrapes.

items.title: Trump seems to mock US women's hockey team while congratulating men on gold
items.description: Viral video of Trump's White House invitation to the US men's hockey team sparks backlash online after the president jokes he would be 'impeached' if he did not also include the gold-medal winning women's team.

items.title: Emergency warnings as intense storms sweep across Melbourne
items.description: Large areas of Melbourne and the Yarra Valley are being urged to shelter indoors as dangerous storms cross the city.

items.title: Live: BHP hits record high before ASX falls amid tariff uncertainty on Wall Street
items.description: With more tariff chaos from US President Donald Trump, unsettling stocks globally, the ASX 200 is in the red on Tuesday, despite opening trading slightly higher. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Former RBA governor calls for capital gains tax discount to be scrapped
items.description: Bernie Fraser tells a Senate committee hearing on capital gains tax that, if it were up to him, he would abolish the discount, as he warns younger Australians are watching the unaffordable housing market in "dismay".

items.title: Live: 'Australia likes being first': PM defends bid to remove Andrew from succession
items.description: The prime minister has revealed he voluntarily wrote to his UK counterpart to offer his support for removing Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor from the line of succession. Follow live.

items.title: New York hires emergency shovelers after blizzard brings city to standstill
items.description: A record-breaking snowstorm pummels the north-eastern United States, bringing cities to a near-standstill for millions of residents.

items.title: 'Silencing mechanism': Football Australia's Matildas FC program angers ex-players
items.description: A new membership program launched by Football Australia puts former Matildas players in a difficult position if they want to criticise the governing body.

items.title: Homeless mother of seven denied social housing over Centrelink income
items.description: Welfare payments are Rissa Blakely's only source of income, but she and her kids have been left with no choice but to live in a park.

items.title: Deal to salvage Zone RV leaves caravan customers short-changed
items.description: A Melbourne-based company has purchased Zone RV, but customers who collectively paid millions before its collapse will be left out of pocket.

items.title: Ancient salamander-crocodile predator revealed by new WA fossil research
items.description: A salamander-crocodile type predator survived five extinction events and travelled from waters off Norway to WA's Kimberley coast.

items.title: The social media ban has hit some families harder than others. Here's why
items.description: We spoke with three parents about how it has impacted their family and the different choices they are making around the ban.

items.title: How the 'first-night effect' is affecting your sleep
items.description: It's night-time and you're exhausted. But the hotel bed feels wrong. The mini fridge won't stop making that low, irritating hum. The power outlet lights feel brighter than the sun.

items.title: Staffing crunch threatens urgent care clinic sustainability
items.description: An independent review finds Labor's urgent care clinics face workforce shortages and problems with after-hours services, with no evidence hospital waiting times have improved.

items.title: Farmers rally against 96 million litres per year water extraction and bottling facility
items.description: A developer has lodged an application with a rural Queensland council to build a water bottling, storage and export facility.

items.title: Woman filmed after allegedly attempting to snatch hijab from teen
items.description: Queensland Police launch an investigation after a woman allegedly attempted to snatch a hijab from a teenage girl on the Brisbane bayside.

items.title: UK's former ambassador to US released on bail as Epstein files fallout continues
items.description: Peter Mandelson, a political powerbroker and former government minister, has been investigated by London's Metropolitan Police for about three weeks over allegations of misconduct in public office.

items.title: Will a couples therapist take sides? An expert explains
items.description: Many people seek out couples counselling when going through a rough patch, or wondering how to improve their relationship. So, how do you decide if it's right for you?

items.title: Agencies put on notice to produce documents for antisemitism inquiry
items.description: A landmark royal commission begins today to probe the prevalence of antisemitism in Australia and shed light on the events surrounding the Bondi Beach terror attack.

items.title: Trump's trade tantrum may drive Canada and Australia closer
items.description: Canberra's decision to sign a bilateral agreement with Canada to join forces on everything to do with critical minerals could prove to be a forerunner of things to come.

items.title: 'In excess of $1 million in tariffs': Exporters hit by trade uncertainty
items.description: Business representatives have warned all Australian exporters they will need to monitor US trade policy carefully over coming weeks and months, as one firm owner estimates tariffs have cost him $1 million.
